ban_va.van_de: Full-sentence production, 2–3 picture retell and letter performance are bundled too early as universal expected outcomes.
ban_va.sua: Keep rich exposure but set one-step/short-phrase/picture-supported communication as CORE; sentence retell and stronger letter links as EMERGING/EXTENSION.
ban_va.phan: CORE = meaningful word/short phrase/2-event communication; EMERGING = linked phrases; EXTENSION = sentence-level retell/letter link.

ban_va.van_de: Too many simultaneous expectations: full conventional sentence, multi-event retell, letter work, tracing/worksheet and routine explanation.
ban_va.sua: Keep oral/phonological richness; separate CORE connected phrase/emerging sentence from EMERGING sentence-level retell and EXTENSION early decoding/writing.
ban_va.phan: CORE = longer phrase/emerging sentence/2-event sequence; EMERGING = 2–3 connected sentences; EXTENSION = verified early decoding/writing.

ban_va.van_de: Multiple valid strands are bundled into one pass condition (sequence narration + phonics + reading + reasoning + group output).
ban_va.sua: Retain all strands but assess them as separate evidence dimensions; do not require independent success across every strand in one week.
ban_va.phan: CORE = complete response + known-code application; EMERGING = connected explanation; EXTENSION = extended reasoning/independent connected response.

ban_va.van_de: Evidence bundle is too dense; oral reasoning is stronger than purposeful independent composition.
ban_va.sua: Separate claim/evidence/revision outcomes from quantity of sentences. Add explicit writing progression: say → plan → segment → write → reread → revise.
ban_va.phan: CORE = connected idea/reason; EMERGING = evidence/revision; EXTENSION = sustained explanation + purposeful written message.

ban_va.van_de: W19–W20 previously used explicit same-first-sound classification for shirt/shorts. W21–W22 were re-read in the live master and now contain action-word listening with no formal phonics; no K/k patch remains there.
ban_va.sua: Reframe as SPEECH-SOUND PLAY: listen, imitate, recognise familiar whole words; optional print exposure only. Remove phoneme/letter classification from core attainment.
ban_va.phan: CORE = whole-word recognition/action/vocal imitation; EMERGING = sound imitation; EXTENSION = brief print noticing only.

ban_va.van_de: Children are asked to group /b/ vs /t/ same-initial pairs as an assessed task.
ban_va.sua: Keep repeated b-/t- sound modelling as playful listening; remove explicit same-first-sound classification from CORE.
ban_va.phan: CORE = listen/choose/recognise/vocalise; EMERGING = imitate beginning; no formal letter/phoneme mastery.

ban_va.van_de: Several weekly outcomes phrase sound→letter connections as universal attainment.
ban_va.sua: Lock rule: phonological noticing = CORE; sound–letter connection = EMERGING/EXTENSION; no decoding/spelling requirement.
ban_va.phan: Applies to I/i, J/j, K/k, L/l, M/m, N/n, O/o, P/p, Q/q, R/r, S/s, T/t, U/u, V/v, W/X, Y/Z as relevant.

ban_va.van_de: Legacy S bank can be misread as S/s representing both /s/ and /ʃ/ because sheep is included.
ban_va.sua: State explicitly: <s> → /s/ in sun/sing/seven; <sh> → /ʃ/ in sheep. Do not imply bare s represents /ʃ/.
ban_va.phan: GREEN may explicitly compare grapheme patterns.

ban_va.tuan: Q/q weeks incl. W33–34 and BLUE W47–48
ban_va.van_de: Bare Q/q is described as = /kw/ in words such as queen, quiet, quack, quick.
ban_va.sua: Teacher-facing phonics must distinguish letter identity from spelling unit: Q/q is the letter target; <qu> commonly represents /kw/ in these source words.
ban_va.phan: YELLOW = optional print noticing; GREEN/BLUE = explicit pattern comparison subject to code gate.

ban_va.van_de: Legacy topic 'Tubers' groups potato, carrot, radish, onion, ginger, garlic, beet, sweet potato as one botanical category.
ban_va.sua: Preserve 'Legacy: Tubers' in provenance, but operational concept should be 'Foods That Grow Underground' / 'Underground Plant Foods'. Do not teach all as tubers.
ban_va.phan: No age group needs formal botany classification as core; GREEN extension may distinguish root/tuber/bulb if useful.

ban_va.van_de: The master note characterises 'made' as irregular relative to simple a_e expectations.
ban_va.sua: Remove the irregular claim. Treat made according to established cumulative a_e code; verify all GPCs before independent reading/spelling.

ban_va.van_de: A source word may be phonically decodable but semantically ambiguous, obsolete, unclear or low-value for preschool (e.g. bass/buff/snuff/tike/lite depending source context).
ban_va.sua: Apply two gates before independent read-and-understand status: CODE GATE + MEANING GATE. If intended meaning is unverified, retain as source/provenance rather than productive vocabulary.
ban_va.phan: CORE/EXTENSION determined by code and meaning readiness, not orthographic pattern alone.

ban_va.van_de: Oral reasoning/source work is stronger than independent composition progression.
ban_va.sua: Add recurring writing cycle where appropriate: say → plan key words → segment → write known-code elements → support untaught spellings → reread → revise one meaningful detail.
ban_va.phan: CORE = meaningful attempt; EMERGING = short message; EXTENSION = connected short writing + revision.

ban_va.van_de: 48-week master content bank is being conflated with the actual 2026–2027 school-year delivery sequence.
ban_va.sua: Lock two layers: (1) 48-week TRUE ENGLISH™ MASTER CONTENT BANK retained intact; (2) separate 2026–2027 DELIVERY MAP for holidays/events/consolidation/portfolio/transition.
ban_va.phan: No child-outcome impact; prevents deleting useful W39–W48 content solely because calendar year uses fewer teaching weeks.

ban_va.van_de: Old build-status text materially understates actual completion and is no longer authoritative.
ban_va.sua: Update master status to: 48/48 weeks populated × 6 groups = 288 age-week units; 288/288 first-pass audited; patch application and final certification still open.

ban_va.van_de: Some outcomes mix child language evidence with editor/source-preservation duties.
ban_va.sua: Child outcomes must describe observable child learning only. Keep source/provenance duties in teacher/editor notes, not child attainment statements.
ban_va.phan: Applies to all ages; strongest issue in later GREEN/BLUE/PURPLE blocks.

ban_va.van_de: W48 is the only week consistently structured as portfolio/reflection/transition across all six groups.
ban_va.sua: Retain W48 narrative Can-Do/support/next-transition evidence with no score/ranking. Use it as the content-bank year-end portfolio endpoint.
